name: Social
overview: Scripture calls believers to actively seek justice and show compassion to those in need, such as the oppressed, fatherless, and widows, emphasizing righteous judgment and care (Isaiah 1:17; Jeremiah 22:3; James 1:27). The golden rule in Matthew 7:12 directs Christians to treat others as they would want to be treated, reflecting Christ's love for the world demonstrated in John 3:16. Wisdom in social interactions is encouraged, urging believers to walk wisely and make the most of opportunities to witness to those outside the faith (Colossians 4:5).
